$comment: Shared browser/backend contract for curve-expression acceptance. The browser sampler (frontend/src/board/expression.ts) is the rendering authority; backend/app/expression_runtime.py must agree on every case unless a deliberate backend-stricter asymmetry is pinned with browser_expect/backend_expect. 'emitted_expr', when present, is what backend normalization must emit for the raw 'expr'; browser expectations apply to the emitted form. Sampling contract: 121 samples over 'domain' (default: the axes x-range), reject any non-finite or complex sample, reject |y| > 1000000, reject a sampled discontinuity > max(10000, |previous| * 100), and require at least one contiguous run of >= 2 samples inside the axes x and y ranges.

cases.name: reciprocal-across-zero
cases.reason: default domain samples x=0 exactly; division produces a non-finite value

cases.name: log-default-domain
cases.reason: default domain includes non-positive x; log is undefined there

cases.name: log-restricted-domain
cases.reason: explicit domain keeps the function finite

cases.name: sqrt-default-domain-negative
cases.reason: default domain includes negative x; sqrt is not real there

cases.name: tan-two-branches
cases.reason: asymptote falls between samples; two visible branches survive range clipping

cases.name: python-power-operator
cases.reason: backend must normalize ** to ^ because mathjs has no ** operator

cases.name: backend-exponent-safety-cap
cases.reason: intentional backend-stricter asymmetry: the bounded interpreter caps exponent magnitude at 32 before evaluation, while mathjs safely samples this finite visible curve

cases.name: offscale-exponential
cases.reason: fewer than two contiguous samples fall inside the axes y-range

cases.name: cached-tangent-line
cases.reason: baseline case from the cached derivative lesson

cases.name: cached-range-curve
cases.reason: baseline case from the cached projectile lesson

cases.name: cached-growth-curve
cases.reason: baseline case from the golden exponential-growth lesson

cases.name: oversized-literal
cases.reason: backend rejects the literal budget; browser rejects the sampled output budget

cases.name: free-variable
cases.reason: only x, pi, and e are legal symbols

cases.name: fractional-power-negative-base
cases.reason: JS produces NaN and Python produces a complex number; both count as non-finite

cases.name: fractional-power-safe
cases.reason: non-negative base keeps the power real

cases.name: singularity-outside-domain
cases.reason: the pole lies outside the sampled domain
